_readme: Round 2 of 7 — big august 9th batch (in-copyright PDFs). Synopses grounded in real detect.mjs-extracted text; mentions curated from candidates.json per docs/detector.md exclusion rules; genres per tools/genres.mjs. Cosmos (Carl Sagan) and Everyman (Philip Roth) are distinct works from same-titled pre-existing DB entries by different authors.

books.title: Carrie
books.author: Stephen King
books.synopsis: Carrie White, a bullied high-school outcast raised by a fanatically religious mother, discovers she has telekinetic powers after her first period triggers a humiliating locker-room hazing; when a prom-night prank goes wrong she turns her power on the town of Chamberlain, Maine. The novel is assembled from Carrie's own narrative interwoven with fictional news clippings, letters, and excerpts from a post-disaster commission report and memoirs by survivors like Susan Snell.

books.title: Caste: The Origins of Our Discontents
books.author: Isabel Wilkerson
books.synopsis: Wilkerson argues that a rigid, largely unspoken caste system, not simply racism, structures American life, and traces its architecture through eight shared pillars found also in the Indian caste system and Nazi Germany's race laws. The book moves between historical case studies (Nazi officials studying American segregation statutes, a schoolteacher's blue-eyed/brown-eyed classroom experiment) and analysis of contemporary events like the police killing of Freddie Gray.

books.title: Child of God
books.author: Cormac McCarthy
books.synopsis: Lester Ballard, dispossessed of his family's Tennessee farm and increasingly shunned by his community, descends into squatting in caves, scavenging, and eventually necrophilia and murder, narrated in spare prose interspersed with the recollections of local townspeople.

books.title: China Rich Girlfriend
books.author: Kevin Kwan
books.synopsis: As Rachel Chu prepares to marry Nick Young, she learns the identity of her long-lost biological father, a mainland Chinese billionaire, and is pulled into the rivalries, scandals, and extravagant spending of Shanghai and Hong Kong's ultra-wealthy alongside Nick's cousin Astrid and the social-climbing Kitty Pong. A running thread involves Kitty's new sister-in-law Colette assigning her a strict etiquette and literary reading curriculum to remake her into old-money society.

books.title: Cities of the Plain
books.author: Cormac McCarthy
books.synopsis: Cowboys John Grady Cole and Billy Parham, now working a New Mexico ranch near the Texas border in the early 1950s, cross into Juárez where John Grady falls for a young epileptic prostitute named Magdalena, setting the pair against a violent pimp. The novel closes the Border Trilogy begun in All the Pretty Horses and The Crossing.

books.title: The Common Reader: Second Series
books.author: Virginia Woolf
books.synopsis: A collection of essays, most first published in periodicals like the Times Literary Supplement and The Nation, in which Woolf writes about English writers and books from the Elizabethans through her own contemporaries, discussing figures such as Sidney, Donne, Defoe, Sterne, Swift, Chesterfield, De Quincey, Cowper, Hazlitt, the Brontes' circle, Elizabeth Barrett Browning, George Gissing, George Meredith, Christina Rossetti, and Thomas Hardy, and closing with an essay on how one should read a book.

books.title: Congo
books.author: Michael Crichton
books.synopsis: In 1979 a corporate-funded expedition led by geologist Karen Ross, primatologist Peter Elliot, his sign-language-trained gorilla Amy, and mercenary guide Charles Munro races into the Zairean rain forest to find a lost city called Zinj and its fabled diamond deposits, following the trail of a previous expedition wiped out by a mysterious force.

books.title: Contact
books.author: Carl Sagan
books.synopsis: Radio astronomer Ellie Arroway leads the SETI-derived Project Argus team that detects and decodes an extraterrestrial signal from Vega, a discovery that leads to construction of an enigmatic interstellar Machine and to Ellie's own journey through it, forcing her and the world to reckon with the boundaries between science, faith, and the numinous.

books.title: Cosmos
books.author: Carl Sagan
books.synopsis: A sweeping popular-science tour of the universe and the history of science, tracing astronomy and cosmology from ancient Ionia and the Library of Alexandria through Kepler, Newton, and Einstein to modern space exploration, while weaving in reflections on the scientific method, the search for extraterrestrial life, and the dangers of nuclear war.

books.title: Crazy Rich Asians
books.author: Kevin Kwan
books.synopsis: When American-born Chinese economics professor Rachel Chu travels to Singapore with her boyfriend Nick Young to attend his best friend's wedding, she discovers he belongs to one of Asia's wealthiest, most status-obsessed families, and must navigate the opulence, gossip, and disapproval of his mother Eleanor and the extended Young-Shang-T'sien clan.

books.title: Daisy Jones & The Six
books.author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
books.synopsis: An oral-history-style novel that reconstructs, through interwoven first-person interview testimony from band members, family, and industry figures, the rise of 1970s rock band Daisy Jones & The Six and the affair, addiction, and creative tensions between singer Daisy Jones and bandleader Billy Dunne that led to the group's abrupt on-stage breakup in Chicago in 1979.

books.title: Death on the Nile
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.synopsis: Heiress Linnet Ridgeway marries Simon Doyle, the former fiancé of her friend Jacqueline de Bellefort, and the newlyweds find Jacqueline pursuing them on their Egyptian honeymoon aboard a Nile steamer; when Linnet is shot dead in her cabin, Hercule Poirot investigates the passengers to find the killer.

books.title: Death's End
books.author: Cixin Liu
books.synopsis: Half a century after the Doomsday Battle, aerospace engineer Cheng Xin wakes from hibernation into the Deterrence Era, in which the threat of mutually-assured destruction between Earth and the Trisolaran invaders has kept an uneasy peace; she inherits the "Swordholder" role controlling humanity's broadcast deterrent, and the narrative follows her choices (and the coded fairy tales sent by Yun Tianming) across the fall of deterrence, humanity's exile to Australia and later the Bunker and Broadcast Eras, and on toward the fate of the solar system.

books.title: Deception
books.author: Philip Roth
books.synopsis: A novel told almost entirely in overheard dialogue between a writer named Philip and his English mistress in London, moving between their pillow talk, arguments about jealousy and fidelity, and his account of researching a biography of the reclusive writer Lonoff whose widow blocked him at every turn; the book ends with the lover confronting him after reading his manuscript about their affair.

books.title: Difficult Loves
books.author: Italo Calvino
books.synopsis: A collection of short stories grouped by period (Riviera Stories, Wartime Stories, Postwar Stories, and Stories of Love and Loneliness), moving between prewar Ligurian coastal boyhood scenes, wartime partisan skirmishes and Allied-occupation port life, and later solitary character studies — a soldier, a bather, a clerk, a reader, a poet — each caught in a single charged encounter or moment of near-connection, rendered through closely observed physical and sensory detail.

books.title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
books.author: Philip K. Dick
books.synopsis: Bounty hunter Rick Deckard, whose wife Iran dials her moods on a Penfield mood organ and who keeps a fake electric sheep because a real animal is beyond his means, is assigned to retire a group of escaped Nexus-6 androids, including Rachael Rosen, Roy and Irmgard Baty, and opera singer Luba Luft, whose deaths leave him shaken and questioning what separates him from them.

books.title: East, West
books.author: Salman Rushdie
books.synopsis: A three-part story collection moving between the subcontinent and the West, retelling Hamlet's gravedigger Yorick as a jester in old Denmark, following Christopher Columbus's years of courting Queen Isabella for patronage, and tracing immigrant friendships and marriages such as those of Chekov and Zulu and the porter Mecir.

books.title: Ender's Game
books.author: Orson Scott Card
books.synopsis: Child prodigy Ender Wiggin is pushed through Battle School's zero-gravity war games, eventually commanding the newly formed Dragon Army of green recruits, before being maneuvered into commanding the fleet that destroys the alien buggers, after which he travels the stars with his sister Valentine as a Speaker for the Dead.

books.title: Everyman
books.author: Philip Roth
books.synopsis: Opening at the graveside funeral of an unnamed former advertising art director, the novel moves back through his childhood hernia surgery, three marriages, his estranged sons and devoted daughter Nancy, art classes at the Starfish Beach retirement community, and a string of worsening cardiac operations that finally kill him on the table.

books.title: Exit Ghost
books.author: Philip Roth
books.synopsis: After eleven years of rural seclusion, the aging, incontinent, impotent writer Nathan Zuckerman travels to Manhattan for a medical procedure, gets drawn into young biographer Richard Kliman's effort to expose a scandal about Zuckerman's late mentor E.I. Lonoff, and is overtaken by a futile infatuation with a much younger writer, Jamie Logan.

books.title: Exit West
books.author: Mohsin Hamid
books.synopsis: In an unnamed city sliding into civil war, Saeed and Nadia fall into a relationship and eventually pass through one of the mysterious doors that have begun appearing worldwide, doors that deposit refugees instantly in Mykonos, London, and finally San Francisco, while their bond slowly erodes as they remake themselves in each new place.

books.title: Fire from Heaven
books.author: Mary Renault
books.synopsis: A childhood-to-adolescence portrait of Alexander the Great growing up in the Macedonian court of his father Philip and his volatile mother Olympias, tutored by Aristotle at Mieza and bound to his lifelong companion Hephaistion, ending as Philip is assassinated and the young Alexander claims the throne.

books.title: Funeral Games
books.author: Mary Renault
books.synopsis: After Alexander the Great's death in Babylon, his generals Perdikkas, Ptolemy, Eumenes, Antigonos, and the rest tear his empire apart in years of shifting alliances, murders, and civil war, while his mother Olympias, his widow Roxane, and his half-witted half-brother Philip Arridaios become pawns and casualties of the succession struggle.

books.title: Fury
books.author: Salman Rushdie
books.synopsis: Malik Solanka, a retired Cambridge historian of ideas and dollmaker who has fled London for New York, tries to escape a rage he cannot explain while his creation Little Brain becomes a global media phenomenon and he is drawn into the affairs of Neela Mahendra and a revolution brewing on the fictional islands of Lilliput-Blefuscu.

books.title: God Help the Child
books.author: Toni Morrison
books.synopsis: Bride, a dark-skinned woman rejected in childhood by her light-skinned mother Sweetness for the color of her own skin, builds a glamorous cosmetics-executive life for herself in adulthood, but it begins to unravel after her lover Booker leaves her and she sets out to find him, uncovering both his and her own buried childhood wounds along the way.
